title: Your Way Out | Behind The Scenes
description:
You can’t escape a system until it exists in the first place. Go behind the lens to see how we brought the world of Your Way Out to life, from life-size video game sets to low-polygon masks (and even some NPC choreography). It takes the village to build a game — but getting out can be as simple as making the choice to.

When you take control of your money, you take control of your life. Coinbase is your way out of their system.
